## What's new

- **The right-hand column has vertical tabs.** The tabs are Tiles (Objects & NPCs in Objects mode), Cell (with the selection), History, Tags & Groups, Layers and Map, each with an icon on the column's edge.
  - One panel shows at a time and fills the column, with one scrollbar instead of scrollbars inside scrollbars. The studio remembers the tab you picked.
  - A dot on the Cell tab shows when a selection is active. Right-click → Cell details opens the Cell tab, and showing a tile in the palette from the Cell panel opens Tiles.
- **"DT1 wall categories" moved** from under the bar above the map to **View → Wall categories…**, which gives the map more room.
- **Cell panel:**
  - **↑ / ↓ buttons** next to × move a tile to the layer above or below, swapping with the tile there. This changes the draw order: higher layers are drawn in front. They're greyed out on Floor 1 / Wall 1 and on Floor 2 / Wall 4.
  - **Each tile's details are folded** behind a Details toggle (kind, indexes, flags, raw bytes and sub-tile flags), so a whole cell fits on screen.
  - **"Unwalkable cell (flag)"** now sits with each tile's other settings, just before Raw bytes. A badge on the folded card shows when it's set.

## Fixes

- **Objects are drawn where the game draws them.** objects.txt Xoffset / Yoffset are now applied, so the chandelier hangs 130 pixels up instead of sitting on the floor. 53 objects use these offsets, including doors, the Duriel's Lair portal, the Mephisto bridge and the Ancients' door.
